title: Sustainable City Plan
description: Structured representation of a procedurally generated sustainable city.

city.description: Global identity, geographic context, population, dimensions, and planning configuration of the city.

id.description: Unique machine-readable identifier for the city plan.

name.description: Human-readable name of the city plan.

target.description: Target population the generated city is designed to accommodate.

current.description: Existing population when the plan represents expansion or redevelopment.

growth_rate.description: Expected annual population growth rate as a decimal.

primary_orientation.description: Primary orientation of the city's urban grid in degrees.

terrain.description: Physical terrain characteristics and generation constraints for the city.

type.description: General morphological classification of the terrain.

slope.description: Terrain slope characteristics and construction constraints.

preferred_building.description: Preferred maximum slope for building placement.

maximum_building.description: Absolute maximum slope allowed for normal buildings.

roughness.description: Controls the spatial variation and smoothness of terrain.

level.description: Overall terrain roughness from smooth (0) to highly irregular (1).

scale.description: Spatial scale of major terrain features.

hydrology.description: Natural water-flow and drainage characteristics of the terrain.

soil.description: Soil characteristics relevant to construction, vegetation, and water management.

bearing_capacity.description: Approximate soil bearing capacity in kPa.

buildability.description: Rules defining which portions of the terrain are suitable for urban development.

climate.description: Climatic conditions and environmental patterns used for urban planning, building design, vegetation, water management, and renewable-energy planning.

classification.description: General climate classification of the city.

annual_average.description: Average annual temperature in degrees Celsius.

minimum.description: Typical minimum temperature in degrees Celsius.

maximum.description: Typical maximum temperature in degrees Celsius.

summer_average.description: Average summer temperature in degrees Celsius.

winter_average.description: Average winter temperature in degrees Celsius.

heatwave_threshold.description: Temperature above which heatwave mitigation becomes important.

coldwave_threshold.description: Temperature below which cold-weather planning becomes important.

annual_average.description: Average relative humidity as a percentage.

solar.description: Solar-resource characteristics used for building orientation, passive design, and solar-energy planning.

annual_solar_energy.description: Estimated annual solar resource in kWh/m²/year.

seasonal_variation.description: Relative seasonal variation in available solar energy.

wind.description: Wind-resource characteristics used for building orientation, ventilation, and wind-energy planning.

average_speed.description: Average wind speed in meters per second.

maximum_speed.description: Typical maximum sustained wind speed in meters per second.

extreme_weather.description: Major climate hazards that influence city planning and infrastructure.

seasons.description: Seasonal climate profile used for annual simulations and sustainability calculations.

sectors.description: Spatially defined districts within the city, each with its own land-use, density, building, street, green-space, service, and development rules.

id.description: Unique machine-readable identifier for the sector.

type.description: Primary land-use classification of the sector.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned bounding rectangle represented as [x, z, width, depth].

polygon.description: Polygon vertices represented as [x, z] coordinates.

daytime_population.description: Expected daytime population including workers, visitors, and residents.

population.description: Target population density in people per square kilometer.

land_use.description: Detailed land-use composition within the sector.

building_rules.description: Rules controlling the type, size, height, spacing, and placement of buildings within the sector.

street_rules.description: Rules for generating the internal street and block structure of the sector.

green_rules.description: Green infrastructure and vegetation requirements for the sector.

services.description: Public and essential services that should be present within the sector.

energy.description: Energy-related requirements and renewable-energy potential within the sector.

ev_charging.description: Whether EV charging hubs and parking should be placed within the sector.

constraints.description: Sector-specific constraints that the planner and generator must respect.

road_graph.description: Hierarchical transportation graph defining the primary road structure and major connectivity of the city.

nodes.description: Important intersections, transportation hubs, gateways, and connection points in the road network.

capacity.description: Approximate number of road connections the node can support.

edges.description: Road segments connecting nodes in the primary transportation network.

hierarchy.description: Default physical and functional characteristics for each road class.

connectivity.description: Network-level connectivity requirements used to evaluate the road system.

generation.description: Rules controlling procedural generation of the road network.

blocks.description: Rules for generating developable urban blocks from the road network and defining their geometry, subdivision, and development.

buildings.description: Global building archetypes and physical rules used to generate buildings within urban plots and sectors.

archetypes.description: Reusable building types that sectors can reference through their building_rules.

generation.description: Controls how buildings are distributed and generated within their available plots.

spacing.description: Minimum spatial separation between generated buildings.

sustainability.description: Building-level sustainability requirements used by the city generator and sustainability analysis.

transport.description: City-wide transportation strategy defining mobility modes, transit, pedestrian and cycling infrastructure, parking, and accessibility requirements.

mode_share.description: Target percentage of trips made using each transportation mode.

public_transport.description: Public transportation network and service requirements.

roads.description: City-wide road traffic management requirements. Major road geometry is defined by road_graph.

accessibility.description: Accessibility requirements for the transportation network.

water.description: City-wide water management strategy covering supply, distribution, consumption, drainage, stormwater, wastewater, and water conservation.

supply.description: Water sources and required supply capacity.

daily_capacity.description: Available daily water supply capacity in cubic meters.

distribution.description: Rules for distributing potable and non-potable water throughout the city.

consumption.description: Water demand targets and consumption assumptions.

target_per_capita_daily.description: Target daily water consumption per person in liters.

stormwater.description: Stormwater management and flood mitigation strategy.

wastewater.description: Wastewater collection, treatment, and reuse strategy.

conservation.description: Water conservation requirements applied across buildings, landscapes, and infrastructure.

energy_zones.description: City-wide renewable energy generation, storage, distribution, and energy infrastructure zones.

generation.description: Renewable and conventional energy generation targets and sources.

distribution.description: Energy distribution and grid architecture requirements.

zoning.description: Rules controlling where energy infrastructure can be located.

vegetation.description: City-wide vegetation strategy defining green-space distribution, vegetation types, tree coverage, biodiversity, and landscape generation.

green_space.description: Distribution and coverage targets for urban green spaces.

trees.description: Urban tree canopy and planting requirements.

minimum_tree_density.description: Minimum number of trees per hectare.

planting.description: Rules governing vegetation placement and landscape design.

biodiversity.description: Requirements for preserving and improving urban biodiversity.

generation.description: Procedural generation parameters for vegetation placement.

environment.description: City-wide environmental protection, resilience, pollution control, resource efficiency, and ecological performance requirements.

air_quality.description: Requirements for maintaining and improving urban air quality.

climate_resilience.description: Measures for adapting the city to climate and extreme weather risks.

natural_resources.description: Requirements for protecting natural resources and environmentally sensitive areas.

sustainability.description: City-wide sustainability targets and performance criteria used to evaluate the environmental, energy, mobility, water, and resource efficiency of the planned city.

energy.description: Targets for renewable energy, energy efficiency, and grid independence.

water.description: Targets for water conservation, reuse, and resource efficiency.

land.description: Targets for efficient and environmentally responsible land use.

environment.description: Environmental performance targets for the city.

carbon_emission_target.description: Target annual carbon emissions per capita in kilograms of CO2 equivalent.

resource_efficiency.description: Targets for minimizing resource consumption and waste.

generation.description: Global procedural generation settings controlling determinism, detail, randomness, and generation behavior of the city.

seed.description: Seed used to produce deterministic procedural generation.

deterministic.description: Whether identical inputs and seed values must produce the same city.

randomness.description: Amount of controlled variation introduced during procedural generation.

lod.description: Level-of-detail settings for large cities and real-time rendering.

coordinate_precision.description: Precision in meters used when generating and placing procedural geometry.

ratio.description: Ratio represented as a value between 0 and 1.
